description: This file defines internal telemetry data structures for OpenTelemetry tracing, including Span, SpanEvent, SpanLink, and related constants and methods for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Span
classes.description: Represents a single operation performed by a component, including trace identifiers, timing, attributes, events, links, and status.

classes.name: SpanEvent
classes.description: A timestamped annotation on a span with a name and attributes.

classes.name: SpanLink
classes.description: A reference from one span to another, possibly in a different trace.

classes.name: SpanFlags
classes.description: Constants for interpreting the span's flags field, used as bit masks.

classes.name: SpanKind
classes.description: Enumeration of span types such as internal, server, client, producer, consumer.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Optional final status for a span (not detailed in the provided code).

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Encodes a Span, SpanEvent, or SpanLink into JSON format following OTLP specifications.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a Span, SpanEvent, or SpanLink following OTLP specifications.
